verdict.rationale: Convex exposes public HTTP endpoints for calling functions (convex-docs-9, convex-docs-31), a documented CLI (convex-probe-5, convex-probe-6), and an official MCP server that AI agents can use to interact with a deployment, verified hands-on via JSON-RPC handshake (convex-docs-10, convex-probe-7). This gives AI-native users multiple documented, programmatic ways to drive the product. Missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (convex-probe-3 shows 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of the HTTP API's completeness beyond first-party docs.
